field.label: Enabled
field.help: This will enable or disable the entry.

field.label: Zone
field.help: The local zone this entry belongs to.

field.label: Domain
field.help: Domain name to match (wildcards like *.example.com are allowed).

field.label: Action
field.help: What to do when this name matches. Redirect requires a target hostname below; Local A/AAAA record requires an IP below.

field.label: Redirect target
field.help: Hostname to redirect to. Only used when Action is Redirect.

field.label: IPv4 address
field.help: Only used when Action is Local A/AAAA record. Answer this name's A query with this address.

field.label: IPv6 address
field.help: Only used when Action is Local A/AAAA record. Answer this name's AAAA query with this address (optional — leave empty for IPv4-only).
